hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""' | { read -r f; echo "$f" | grep -qE '/(app|components|lib)/' && printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"DOC CHECK: file edited in a tracked domain (app/, components/, lib/). Ask yourself: does this change affect project structure, stack, pages, animation architecture, or multi-agent domain ownership? If yes, update the relevant doc — README.md for structure/stack/pages, CLAUDE.md for architecture/patterns, AGENTS.md for domain ownership/coordination rules. Skip if the change is a routine bug fix or style tweak with no structural impact."}}' || true; }
